item.title: Top 5 Methods to Extract Pattern Matches with Python Regular Expressions
item.description:
I am attempting to extract words that match a specific pattern using regular expressions in Python. Consider the following string containing various lines:

someline abc
someother line
name my_user_name is valid
some more lines

My goal is to capture the word my_user_name. I will now demonstrate how to achieve this using different techniques with Python’s re module.

Method 1: Utilize Matching Groups

By employing matching groups in your regex, you can extract specific parts of the matched text.
